body:
## AI Code Review — PR #15

4 findings (2H 0M 2L). Worst: Leftover `Awesome()` boilerplate usage breaks compilation and tests.

**Spec Assessment:** The spec (#5) is fully implemented. The Riverpod DI, GoRouter setup, and EventBus composition root are properly configured. However, the boilerplate test/example files in the `messaging` package cause analysis and test failures.

comments.body:
**[Standards]** `High`

The `Awesome` class was removed from `messaging_base.dart`, so this example will fail to compile. This breaks `melos run analyze`.

> Rule: Code must compile and pass analysis (AGENTS.md §Workflow)

```suggestion
  var eventBus = SyncEventBus();
  print('eventBus: $eventBus');
```

**[Standards]** `Low`

The description is still the default Dart package boilerplate. Consider updating it to reflect the `messaging` context.

```suggestion
description: The messaging context containing EventBus and DomainEvent for Cuentaria.
```

**[Standards]** `Low`

The README contains the default dart boilerplate `TODO` blocks. We should probably clean this up.

```suggestion
## Features

Provides `EventBus` and `DomainEvent` for the Cuentaria composition root.
```
